scope: PRSN-04 person flag-code producer and negative display-consumer audit

evidence.serialization: prsn +0x4C loads into Person +0x9C with 0xFFFF normalized to runtime -1; save, copy and compare paths preserve it
evidence.generation: one generated family-name index 0..103 selects both the family-name resource and a parallel flag code
evidence.parallel_table: the 104-byte table contains 104 distinct codes in range 2..173
evidence.inheritance: new persons copy a nonempty flag code from a base person whose first two family-name bytes match, otherwise store no code
evidence.remaining_gap: the current EXE has no display, text-resource, font-atlas or gameplay consumer for Person +0x9C, so code-to-character mapping needs resource data or a repeatable display experiment

ida_changes.read_back: All three function names, the data name and all six comments were visible after save and forced recompile; generated and inherited flag-code paths use the new symbols
